picks.title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
picks.excerpt: After running on 16,000+ submissions at STOC, ICML, NeurIPS and ICLR, Google's AI peer-review system Deep Review launches publicly for rigorous verification of mathematical and scientific documents.
picks.rationale: Primary-source public launch of an AI peer-review/verification tool already battle-tested on 16,000+ conference submissions; directly changes how researchers check papers.

picks.title: HiRO-ACEv2: Simulating extreme weather at 3 km resolution for a fraction of the cost
picks.excerpt: Ai2's ML climate emulator HiRO-ACEv2 captures extreme rain, wind and pressure events at 3 km resolution for about 1/300th the cost of the X-SHiELD physics model.
picks.rationale: New model release from the lab: km-scale extreme-weather emulation at ~1/300th the compute of the physics baseline, a concrete quantitative leap.

picks.title: Amateur astronomer harnesses AI to find a possible hidden exoplanet
picks.excerpt: Evidence for a possible super-Earth had been lurking for years in NASA TESS data; amateur Pavel Rabtsevich found it with help from AI tools.
picks.rationale: Astronomy angle missing from recent cards: an amateur used AI tools to surface a candidate super-Earth in archival TESS data.

picks.title: New 'First Proof' exam reveals how AI-powered math is a pay-to-play sport
picks.excerpt: A new research-level math benchmark confirms some frontier AIs are becoming exceptional tools for mathematicians, while open-source models still struggle.
picks.rationale: New research-level math benchmark result with a clear finding (frontier vs open-source gap); the single AI-math pick today, distinct from prior proof/record stories.

picks.title: AI-enhanced weather model doubles predictive power two to six weeks out
picks.excerpt: MIT-led researchers built a machine-learning layer that learns and corrects ECMWF forecast errors, roughly doubling subseasonal (2-6 week) skill and improving extreme-weather prediction.
picks.rationale: MIT-led ML correction layer roughly doubles 2-6 week forecast skill on ECMWF output; a different problem (subseasonal correction) from HiRO's km-scale emulation.
